Dear Osama Omar,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and for the delay in resolving your concerns.

We have received an update from the team that the WiFi is now working. Kindly try turning it off and on again, and it should function properly.

Regarding the parking card, please allow us some time to check with the concerned team and we will update you shortly with a solution.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding.
